answer.policy_title: Cohere Medical Policy - Great Toe Surgical Treatments (Version 3), Avera Health Plans
criteria_quotes: Failure of conservative management for greater than 3 months, including ALL of the following
Taping or splinting; OR Toe spacer; OR Toe sleeve; OR Padding
Oral steroids, topical or oral anti-inflammatory medications, or oral analgesics
Documentation of near or full skeletal maturity as indicated by first metatarsal physeal closure or near closure

Documentation of connective tissue or neuromuscular disorders that may affect etiology or severity of the condition (e.g., Cerebral Palsy, Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Marfan Syndrome, Osteogenesis Imperfecta, Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva)
The procedure is a bunionectomy with osteotomy, and ALL of the following
Current nicotine user with no product use for 6 weeks; and ANY of the following
Negative urine (cotinine) lab test within 30 days
Surgery is urgently required due to documented reason
No history of nicotine product use within the last 12 months
No lifetime history of nicotine product use
The patient has ANY of the following positive findings
Pain, swelling, or limited range of motion (ROM) at the first metatarsophalangeal (MTP) joint
Difficulty walking due to pain in the MTP joints
Non-healing ulceration caused by the bunion
Malunion or non-union of previous surgery
Radiographic confirmation with radiologic report (must be weight-bearing radiographs of the foot) of ALL of the following
HV angle greater than 15°; OR IM angle greater than 9°
answer.submission_route: Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter, or call the number on the back of your insurance card and ask where member appeals are filed.
